scope: Follow-up to 12 survivors in v7; complete campaign v8 finished and failed
production_changes: Explicit fixed codec geometry selects at most 256 decoded floats per chunk: F32 1024 bytes, F16 512, Q4_0 18, Q8_0 34, Q6_K 210. Replaces equivalent derived chunk arithmetic.
Elapsed phase addition is shared in accumulate_time and tested with deterministic durations instead of wall-clock timing assertions.
Raw negative JSON numbers now return InvalidType directly. Signed metadata integers remain canonical strings; valid input representation is unchanged.
contracts: Importer external reservation leaves exactly 62 encoder bytes; failure must occur in the encoder rather than after allocation.
Invalid first block coverage must be rejected before a later excessive record can change the diagnostic.
The wrong number of complete terms yields StreamError::Length before domain depth validation.
Unsupported null has a useful internal serde expectation and maps to public InvalidJson.
comparison_policy: Changed geometry and timing factoring can change candidate counts; removed candidates are not caught mutants.
snapshot_note: After campaign launch, writer.rs header function was moved above its new test module to resolve items_after_test_module. No function body changed in this reorder. Gate hashes refer to the reordered tree; campaign line numbers may differ.

complete_campaign_v8.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo mutants -p bml-model-weights --all-features --cargo-arg=--locked --test-workspace false --jobs 2 --timeout 60 --build-timeout 300 --output target/model-weights-mutations-v8
